steps.note: Carry-over: Kowalczyk taken in m09. Cuffed at the second van; the aside answer 'In Helena' is stored as bench.

said: Quintero cuffs Kowalczyk without a word.
That was your work in Helena. It held.
Kowalczyk sits in the back of the second van, cuffed.
She was the one the ledger meant.
She turns back to the window. Quintero shuts the van door.
notSaid: One place at the table is empty.
Kowalczyk hands you a PIN cracker
Their ledger calls that person WREN
Kowalczyk goes ahead on her own
